# Historical AI Select v1 test fixtures

These immutable runtime-test inputs were copied byte-for-byte from commit
`504e8885b87575761dc2e367e520b7dfba46884b` after PR #48 removed the legacy
`docs/**` benchmark tree.

They exist only to keep historical Companion parsers, digest locks, and
reference paths executable. They are not current product authority, benchmark
promotion evidence, or a replacement documentation control plane. Current
AI Select v2 planning authority remains GitHub Issue #37 and its child Issues.
